retained_laws.scope_note: Exact retained original law. Locally Noetherian original scheme; n>=1; basis on a neighborhood; every arbitrary commutative affine target R. Uses actual Moduli.toPolAV at n=1. No flatness, reducedness or Noetherianity restriction on R.

retained_laws.exact_definition_text:
def SecBaseChangeSt : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Scheme.{0}) [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (P : PolAV S) (n : ℕ), 1 ≤ n →
    ∀ p : S, ∃ V : S.Opens, p ∈ V ∧ ∃ b : Fin (n ^ P.g) → LB.Sec (LPow P.A P.L n (overRes (T := baseOver S) V)),
      ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R] (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of R) ⟶ (overRes (T := baseOver S) V).left)
        (b' : Fin (n ^ P.g) → LB.Sec (LPow P.A P.L n (baseAt t))),
        (∀ i, IsPullSec P.A P.L n (homAt t ▷ P.A) (whiskerRight_snd (homAt t) P.A) (b i) (b' i)) →
        LinearIndependent Γ((baseAt t).left, ⊤)
            (fun i => (SecM.ofSec P.A (b' i) : SecM P.A P.L n (baseAt t))) ∧
          Submodule.span Γ((baseAt t).left, ⊤)
            (Set.range fun i => (SecM.ofSec P.A (b' i) : SecM P.A P.L n (baseAt t))) = ⊤

retained_laws.name: SecTwistSt
retained_laws.scope_note: Exact retained original law for arbitrary original S/P, q>=1, all local coefficient rings, translated line, q^g basis and every residue-section lift. The proof only consumes its actual complex-fiber instances, but does not claim the global supplier.

source.declaration: Retained exact SecTwistSt: all local rings, twisted bases and residue-section lifts

retained_laws.exact_definition_text:
def SecTwistSt : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : Scheme.{0}) (P : PolAV S) (q : ℕ), 1 ≤ q →
    ∀ (R : Type) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] (t : Spec (CommRingCat.of R) ⟶ S)
      (c : Over.mk t ⟶ P.A),
      (∃ b : Fin (q ^ P.g) → LB.Sec (twistLB P.A P.L q c), IsSecBasis _ b) ∧
      ∀ sbar : LB.Sec (LB.LinComb P.L (K := Fin 2)
          (fun k => ((Over.homMk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue R))) rfl :
            Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (IsLocalRing.residue R)) ≫ t) ⟶ Over.mk t) ▷ P.A).left ≫
              ![(snd (Over.mk t) P.A).left, (translPt P.A c).left] k) ![(q : ℤ) - 1, 1]),
        ∃ s : LB.Sec (twistLB P.A P.L q c), IsPullSecLC P.L _ _ _ s sbar

Borel and arithmetic witnesses t are selected before every allowed a,n; no bounded-weight replacement.

EvalWD allows arbitrary target rings. The all-point weight law uses reduced target S precisely because TDR13 supplies FromTest there.
Frame/generator holomorphy allows arbitrary possibly nonreduced, non-Noetherian coefficient R; it uses finitely many local coefficient expressions.
HolEval allows arbitrary normed complex V and arbitrary subset B with DifferentiableOn, matching the original helper scope.
CoverTri and FibTri quantify over every supplied derivative realization and retain exact original period maps and dependent component equalities.
HasPrinc uses l.M prime = lcm(l.M,l.A); the ExpoMatch statement assumes l.A=1 and retains the original level l.M.
